title: Parallax visual identity studies
status: All 13 alternative directions have generated still studies; animation assessments remain untested design hypotheses.
scene: Child holding a coin opposite a shopkeeper, loaf on counter; shared scene to compare illustration directions.

studies.name: Modern woodcut
studies.style: Medium and identity: an original sophisticated contemporary WOODCUT / LINOCUT editorial print, carrying constructivism's strong composition into hand-carved relief printing. Broad confident irregular black shapes, angular carved silhouettes, LARGE purposeful bone gouge marks following forms, no fine filigree or uniform crosshatching. Clear bold counter diagonal and an amber rectangular window-light shape. Bone paper remains visible in calm areas. Adult and child noses and hands carved as clean profile silhouettes; skin is a few solid planes without polygon tessellation. Tactile ink edge breakup only where a carved block would create it. Rich composition, very economical marks, severe but humane. This should convincingly resemble ink transferred from hand-cut blocks, not a photograph processed with a texture filter. Flat 2D printed light, no atmospheric gradients. No Soviet-poster rhetoric, no propaganda poses.

studies.name: Layered paper theatre
studies.style: Medium and identity: a mature modernist CUT-PAPER THEATRE illustration, a shallow stage assembled from hand-cut colored paper. People, counter, window frame and shelf are separate distinct silhouettes and broad paper pieces with elegant irregular scissor-cut edges. Use 4 readable depth layers with small matte seam shadows at overlaps, natural paper fibers visible only subtly. Flatten perspective, sculpt volume by overlapping paper shapes rather than tonal rendering. Adult and child are sophisticated articulated paper puppets, continuous clean limbs with simple overlapping elbow pieces, profile noses cut with one deliberate contour, featureless faces from unprinted bone paper, NOT polygon masks. Counter one walnut plane, amber window plane, ink apron, bone backdrop, grey-green wall. No intricate patterned paper, no curled rosettes, no scrapbook scraps or visible pins. Adult audience, thoughtful essay animation design, not a children's craft project. Handmade paper depth is illustrative and shallow, not photorealistically photographed or rendered in polished 3D. Strong composition with calm blank surfaces.

studies.name: Charcoal and spot color
studies.style: Medium and identity: a sophisticated hand-drawn CHARCOAL AND DRY INK illustration on warm bone paper, with a SINGLE amber spot-color field at the window and small coin. Irregular searching contour strokes with purposeful line-weight variation, a few bold velvety charcoal masses, visible eraser-lifted highlights, soft dry smudges contained within chosen shadow areas. Most paper left CLEAN. Human figures loosely drawn with anatomical coherence, distinctive casual garments, minimal anonymous faces suggested by jaw, nose and ear contour, no faceted polygons, no eye detail. Main detail at hands and loaf; background shelf and room indicated with a handful of confident lines, deliberately unfinished edges. Sophisticated illustrated literary journal, emotionally present, no photoreal anatomy rendering. Warm, intimate and intelligent. Asymmetrical negative space, fresh contemporary drawing rather than antique sepia. Use amber only as flat accent, not all-over warm wash. No uniformly applied gritty filter, no dense hatching wallpaper.

studies.name: Editorial gouache
studies.style: Medium and identity: an original mature EDITORIAL GOUACHE painting, clearly hand-painted opaque shapes with beautiful economical bristle strokes, slight dry-brush edge breaks and chosen broad tonal transitions. Quiet modernist observational painting, flattened perspective and slightly exaggerated human proportions, warm human narrative. Rounded organic head and shoulder shapes instead of polygon geometry; noses, jawlines and ears in two or three calm color planes, anonymous faces without detailed eyes or mouths. Give the bread several beautifully observed brush marks, let cloth be broad ink strokes, leave wall a calm pale grey-green field and window a strong flat amber rectangle. Rich visual detail through edge variety, deliberate irregularity and a few considered brush strokes, not intricate surface patterns. Three-value shape design, bone paper luminosity, reserved ink shadows, not brown sludge. No oil impasto, no realistic skin, no volumetric cinematic light, no whimsical storybook cuteness, no slick vector icon people. Painting should look deliberately designed by an illustrator.

studies.style: Medium and identity: a sophisticated TWO-INK RISOGRAPH / screenprinted editorial illustration on warm BONE paper. Broad flat modernist shapes with slightly imperfect contours, tactile dense pigment, LARGE sparse stipple clusters in selected shadows rather than fine regular halftone grids. Contemporary literary arts publication, elegantly awkward human proportions, graceful casual clothing, simple anonymous profile faces, no triangulated heads, no corporate flat-vector blobs. Child, adult, counter and jars resolved from economical silhouettes and a few fine ink drawing lines. Architecture partly represented by absence and negative space. Distinct focal accent on coin and window. No all-over grain filter, no retro poster typography, no gradients. Legible confident composition with sparse crafted detail.

studies.name: Graphic risograph in indigo and vermilion
studies.prompt:
Use case: visual identity illustration for an original arts-led philosophical video essay channel called Parallax. Create a single finished landscape 16:9 illustration. Art direction: BOLD FLAT GEOMETRIC TWO-INK RISOGRAPH, visually spare and unmistakably designed, sophisticated contemporary arts quarterly. Strong unfamiliar composition, purposeful asymmetry, simple shapes with irregular hand-drawn edges. Strict two inks INDIGO BLUE #2648A3 and VERMILION #E45E3D on clean WARM BONE #F4EDDE paper. Only those colors and a dark blue-red overprint where inks overlap. Absolutely NO sepia, brown, yellow, gray-green, charcoal rendering or realistic shaded illustration. Large solid areas of opaque printed ink; edges slightly imperfect. Very subtle paper tooth, ink texture limited to a few coarse dry gaps. No all-over speckle, no crosshatching, no tonal gradient.
Scene to portray: a child on the left holding a single small vermilion coin in one carefully drawn hand, an adult shopkeeper on the right behind a long counter, one large loaf on the counter between them. Three blank jars on a short shelf behind the adult. Window at upper left represented by a huge vermilion semicircle cropped by the left and top edges and one thin indigo bar. Room is suggested through wide areas of empty bone paper, no realistically rendered bakery, no shelves full of bread, no foliage, no decorative domestic props. The counter is a wide indigo trapezoid with a slightly skewed top, sharp deliberate corners, with only two thin vermilion irregular strokes for the front. Bread as an oblong vermilion print shape with three bone cutout slashes and a dark overprinted lower edge.
Human design: elegant slightly elongated limbs, compact heads and broad simple clothing silhouettes. Smooth organic heads in anonymous side profile, each with one distinct nose contour and a tiny ear curve; no eyes, no mouths, no polygon masks. Child indigo coat with one vermilion cuff stripe; adult bone shirt defined by an indigo contour and indigo apron shape with a vermilion strap. Hands anatomically readable, economical contour, separated clearly from loaf and each other. Both people stand quietly facing each other. Hand, shoulder, sleeve and apron each designed with a small number of deliberate printed shapes and one or two precise line details.
This is a modernist printed composition with material specificity, adult editorial tone and visual wit. Keep 45 percent of image as clean bone negative space. No little title, no letters or symbols, no logo or watermark. No photography, no 3D, no lens effect, no soft digital painting. No corporate blob people or oversized featureless paddle hands. The scene should read clearly from across a room.

studies.name: Modernist cel animation
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: mature modernist CEL ANIMATION DESIGN. A hand-inked frame on flat painted fields, boldly two dimensional. Thin irregular black-blue ink contours that sometimes stop short of color shapes, asymmetrical perspective, slightly angular shoulders but organic compact heads, tapered human limbs with believable joints. Expressive opposing poses: child leaning forward slightly, adult attentive with one elbow loosely bent. Clearly designed cuffs, apron tie, two careful finger shapes at the coin, a few bread slashes. Room reduced to three large architectural shapes; don't render every surface. A huge pale blue window and a skewed muted coral wall plane counterbalance a deep navy apron and counter. Palette: clean ivory, dark midnight blue, dusty cyan and restrained red-orange. Controlled flat fills, almost no shading, subtle hand-ink irregularity; no grain wash or vintage yellowing. Sparse lines and strongly designed poses convey observed human feeling. It should look like an ambitious theatrical animated film frame, never a retro mascot, stock cartoon, comic panel or vector infographic.
studies.prompt:
Create an original 16:9 still in a rigorously flat mid-century MODERNIST CEL ANIMATION design language, informed by UPA's bold abstraction. Adult philosophical film, visually witty and humane. The entire composition consists of flat opaque fields and a few lively irregular blue-black ink contours. Angular asymmetric rooms, compact oval heads with one hooked nose, simple hair silhouettes, narrow jointed limbs, broad triangular apron, specific small hands. Design every person from 6–10 large shapes with NO anatomical shading, skin rendering, beard strands or realistic fabric folds. Color planes occasionally sit slightly apart from the drawn contour. Pale ivory, dusty cyan, deep navy and one vivid coral wall. No texture filters.
Scene: a child on the LEFT holds one small coral coin toward an adult shopkeeper on the RIGHT behind a broad skewed counter. One flat oval loaf between them with three slashes, three jars drawn as spare loops behind the adult, large cyan window left. Keep silhouettes and hands distinct, posture expressive. Room mostly clean empty fields. Deliberately stylized geometry and graphic surprise, not anime, not realistic illustration, no text, no additional props.

studies.name: Conceptual line drawing
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: conceptual PEN DRAWING as visual thought, elegant, cerebral and quietly witty. Clean warm-white paper occupies most of the frame. A single sinuous blue-black contour appears to travel from the window's boundary into the counter edge, then naturally becomes the adult's apron seam: an intelligible visual connection across spatial elements, still preserving readable people. Spare but specific irregular pen marks, light and heavy line decisions, beautiful open contours. Child and adult have distinct long nose/ear/jaw profiles, compact believable proportions and subtly observed stances, without eyes or mouth. Loaf drawn with only a few precise marks and three slashes. THREE jars as bare looping contours. Only two very small opaque vermilion fields: the coin and a small shape at window edge. Room largely unstated. No shading, hatching clouds, charcoal smudge, paper collage or photoreal volume. The main visual event is an inventive continuous line organizing the scene, not a generic whiteboard-explainer outline picture. Let its spatial double reading be legible and deliberate. Detail resides in the precision and personality of the marks.

studies.name: Architectural surrealism
studies.style: Medium and spatial rules: architectural SURREALISM painted in matte restrained opaque color. Use austere simplified contemporary architecture, long hard-edged shadows and an emotionally present tiny everyday encounter. The left half of the bread shop and the right half are each internally clear but meet at ONE deliberate spatial contradiction: the long counter changes its vanishing direction at the loaf, as if two legitimate viewpoints share one continuous surface. Keep counter usable and hands/body anatomy completely ordinary; the contradiction belongs to architecture. A tall window reveals a perfectly flat muted cyan rectangle. A doorway-like empty wall recess behind the adult has a vermilion interior plane, giving a memorable asymmetrical spatial anchor without additional objects. People occupy enough of frame to read posture and coin clearly, with sculptural simple painted profiles and economical clothing folds. Palette cool mineral blue, pale chalk, muted terra-cotta and near-black blue shadows; no nostalgic brown wash. Calm broad surfaces, slight dry painted edges and carefully chosen tonal planes. Enigmatic thoughtful atmosphere rather than horror, fantasy or dramatic digital concept art. No floating props, no extra loaves, no melting people. Spatial strangeness must feel intentional, composed and intellectually useful.
studies.prompt:
Create an original 16:9 METAPHYSICAL ARCHITECTURAL SURREALIST PAINTING for an adult philosophical film, informed by Giorgio de Chirico's simplified spaces and strange perspective. Clearly nonrealistic and visibly painted: large matte chalk-blue, ivory, burnt-vermilion and deep indigo planes, spare brush edges. No photographic rendering. TWO deliberately simplified human figures have smooth anonymous oval profile heads, noses defined only by silhouette, no eyes, no detailed hair or beard, no skin modeling. Clothes and limbs are sculpted from only two or three broad painted planes with coherent small hands.
A child stands LEFT holding one small coin toward a shopkeeper RIGHT behind a long counter. ONE loaf at center, three jars on one shelf behind the adult, large plain pale blue window left. A tall vermilion empty recess behind the adult anchors the room. ONE purposeful spatial contradiction: left and right halves of the counter have incompatible vanishing directions but join at the loaf as a continuous impossible surface. Long clean diagonal shadows. Humans remain prominent and tender through posture. Quiet cerebral tension, austere calm architecture, no extra objects, no text, no creepy faces, no floating bread, no realism, no 3D render.

studies.name: Ink wash with crisp figures
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: contemporary INK WASH with crisp drawn HUMAN FIGURES. The background is organized by two broad translucent cool blue-gray brush washes, substantial untouched ivory paper and one restrained vermilion shape at the window. Visible diluted pigment pooling only at selected wash edges, expressive wet-to-dry transitions, no uniform grunge overlay. People have sharp blue-black economical ink contours and flat dark clothing shapes, more defined than the atmospheric room. Child's wrist, coat cuff and coin and adult's apron, hand and ear are drawn with a few carefully observed marks. Bread is a pale reserved-paper shape against a dark counter wash, with three assured brush slashes. THREE jars remain simple crisp outlines. Architecture can disappear into clean paper between strokes, but the people, coin and counter remain legible. Cool airy modernity, emotional restraint, brush specificity and spaciousness; no landscape foliage, no decorative blossoms, no antique scroll motifs, no cutesy watercolor or brown vintage illustration. The contrast between fluid atmosphere and sharply human contours is the identity.
